operations.description: Checks replication consistency based on a consistency token, that is, if replication has caught up based on the conditions specified in the token and the check request.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables check consistency [PATH] name check consistency [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] check consistency request response

operations.description: Permanently drop/delete a row range from a specified table. The request can specify whether to delete all rows in a table, or only those that match a particular prefix. Note that row key prefixes used here are treated as service data. For more information about how service data is handled, see the [Google Cloud Privacy Notice](https://cloud.google.com/terms/cloud-privacy-notice).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables drop row range [PATH] name drop row range [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] drop range request row

operations.description: Generates a consistency token for a Table, which can be used in CheckConsistency to check whether mutations to the table that finished before this call started have been replicated. The tokens will be available for 90 days.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables generate consistency token [PATH] name generate consistency token [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] consistency generate request response token

operations.description: Performs a series of column family modifications on the specified table. Either all or none of the modifications will occur before this method returns, but data requests received prior to that point may see a table where only some modifications have taken effect.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables modify column families [PATH] name modify column families [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] backup change cluster column config encryption families family gc info modification modify request restore rule state stats stream table

operations.description: Restores a specified table which was accidentally deleted.

operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances app profiles create [PATH] app profiles [PARAMS] access alt app callback fields id ignore key oauth parent pretty print profile protocol quota token type upload user warnings xgafv [SCHEMA] any app cluster isolation multi profile routing single standard use

operations.description: Starts creating a new Cloud Bigtable Backup. The returned backup long-running operation can be used to track creation of the backup. The metadata field type is CreateBackupMetadata. The response field type is Backup, if successful. Cancelling the returned operation will stop the creation and delete the backup.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances clusters backups create [PATH] backups [PARAMS] access alt backup callback fields id key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] backup encryption info operation

operations.description: Copy a Cloud Bigtable backup to a new backup in the destination cluster located in the destination instance and project.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances clusters backups copy [PATH] backups copy [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] backup copy operation request

operations.description: Creates a cluster within an instance. Note that exactly one of Cluster.serve_nodes and Cluster.cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config can be set. If serve_nodes is set to non-zero, then the cluster is manually scaled. If cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config is non-empty, then autoscaling is enabled.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances clusters create [PATH] clusters [PARAMS] access alt callback cluster fields id key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] autoscaling cluster config encryption limits operation targets

operations.description: Create an instance within a project. Note that exactly one of Cluster.serve_nodes and Cluster.cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config can be set. If serve_nodes is set to non-zero, then the cluster is manually scaled. If cluster_config.cluster_autoscaling_config is non-empty, then autoscaling is enabled.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances create [PATH] instances [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] cluster config create encryption instance operation request

operations.description: Creates a new table in the specified instance. The table can be created with a full set of initial column families, specified in the request.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables create [PATH] tables [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] backup change cluster column config create encryption family gc info request restore rule split state stats stream table

operations.description: Create a new table by restoring from a completed backup. The returned table long-running operation can be used to track the progress of the operation, and to cancel it. The metadata field type is RestoreTableMetadata. The response type is Table, if successful.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] bigtableadmin projects instances tables restore [PATH] tables restore [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] operation request restore table
